description: Look up the verdict the public catalogue has published for an MCP server package on npm or PyPI. Returns found:false when the catalogue has no published verdict for that name; that is not a clean result. Nothing is downloaded or scanned. This request names the package to the server; to match without naming it, download /api/reputation-feed.json and match on your side.

version.description: Optional: the version you plan to install; the reply says whether the published verdict is for it

name: lookup_verdict
title: Look up a published MCP server verdict
